items.text: Today's patch includes a handful of minor bug fixes and balance tweaks that we didn't get in before the official launch. Please see below for details:
The female Exo Armour unit's combat drug ability now works properly.
Fixed some barricades that were not visible during the final levels.
Female exo armour's icon provides a visual indication that she can equip swords.
Increased plasma bot ranged damage by 5.
Female Combat Droids can now equip pistols.
Male Combat Droids can now equip flamers.
The camera now focusses on the mid point between attacker and target during an enemy's attack so that both attacker and target are in the screen.
Reduced the size and font of the tutorial window on levels with tutorial sections.
Reduced the size of the message window on team selection that lets you choose between a pre-made team or a manually selected one.

This update brings us within spitting distance of our full release (hopefully next week on Thursday) and includes the final 2 character classes for the roster. The male Exo Armour trooper is a power-armoured brute carrying a huge rotary canon. The female variant is completely different and is melee focused ... though she also carries a grenade launcher. Both units are very heavily armoured and can dish out a lot of damage but somewhat cumbersome so have no counter attacks on their base profile and are on the slower side. Please try them out and let us know how you like them.
Exo Armour male and female character classes added to roster.
Added tutorial prompt on campaign 14 to help guide the player to the computer terminal.
Reduced number of enemy patrols on campaign 15 and 16.
Increased difficulty slightly on campaign 19.
Fusion grenade item now damages enemy correctly.

topNew: Exo Armour male and female character classes added to roster.
Added tutorial prompt on campaign 14 to help guide the player to the computer terminal.

items.text: Today's patch provides the long-awaited redesign for the Technomancer class. The male Technomancer is summoning focused while the female is more defensive and focused on providing mobile energy shields and terrain buffs. In addition, the update includes improvements to the HUD, some bug fixes and balance adjustments for the final campaign missions. It also includes a proper campaign ending scene. Assuming that no major bugs or issues are identified, this version should be close to the final, proper launch version and should mark the closing of the early access period.
Added the Plasma Bot as a new summoned unit for the male Technomancer. This unit is a mobile gun drone that has various experimental weapons and will explode if destroyed.

The team summary in the UI now displays icons for units that have been summoned during battle and those for controllable allies. This allows players to see their stats at a glance and select them more easily from the HUD just as they can for team members.
Added a new and more detailed skymap for campaign missions 30 to 40.
Reduced the size of the mission briefing screen at the start of a mission.
The cryo shot and heavy beam abilities now work correctly.
Fixed a bug where hovering over a tile would not show which enemy units are in attack range from that position correctly.
Fixed a bug where player character's attack ranges were being reduced by 1 incorrectly.
The character's stat sheet now correctly displays remaining counter attacks, life and action points rather than the values at the start of a battle.
Several minor bugs fixed.
The Instill Fear ability now correctly reduces morale.

Changed the abilities of the male and female Technomancer to be more useful and in-theme. The male is now focused on summoning robotic allies into combat while the female is focused on setting up strong defensive positions with portable shields and turrets.
Increased range of cryo shot ability.
Increased movement range of Veteran Vanguard.
The "Long Range Mastery" passive ability has been changed to be useful for Devastators since they already automatically hit with their ranged attacks.
Increased ranged damage of Tesla Trooper classes by 5 points.
Increased movement range of the Suppressor class.
Moved the game rules section to the main menu in the mission select / team management screen.
Added glowing lights to buttons in mission select / team management screen.
Removed the autosave element of the game as it was unreliable.
Sniper Rifles and Machine Gun labels now show on item tooltip.
Restocking the vendor now removes old items from stock properly.
Changed display of "Leggings" to "Greaves" in item tooltip.
Barrels in campaign 1 now provide proper cover.
Enemy units can now be mind controlled properly.
Screen-edge Mouse pan left / right and up / down now move at the correct speed.
Changed items that boosted sight range to boost action points instead as it is a more useful stat.
Ignored mouse pan, zoom and rotate commands during the action cam scenes.

topNew: Moved the game rules section to the main menu in the mission select / team management screen.
Added glowing lights to buttons in mission select / team management screen.

items.text: Shield items added for the Bastion classes.
Grenade (bomb) items added for all classes.
New achievement added for completing the first campaign mission.
New alien commander unit added to the campaign story.
Some new tutorial prompts added to early campaign levels.
Added an option to toggle whether the camera follows a unit as it moves.
Added drag and drop as an option for moving items in the shop / inventory screen.
Fixes a bug that was preventing steam achievements for being achieved.
Fixed a black screen that would appear the first time campaign 28 is completed.
Key re-bindings are now applied properly.
Brood Champions now display a life bar circle underneath them.
Several minor bug fixes.
Increased movement range of all units by 1.

topNew: Shield items added for the Bastion classes.
Grenade (bomb) items added for all classes.
New achievement added for completing the first campaign mission.

items.text: Today's patch has some minor fixes and balance tweaks as well as an early build of a tutorial in the first two campaign levels. As always, appreciate all feedback.
Tutorial added to campaign mission 1.
Tutorial added to campaign mission 2.
Camera should now properly follow units when they move.
Campaign level 16 reduced in difficulty significantly.

Scorcher alien's "Hard to Kill" passive ability reduced in impact. It now grants only +5 armour / +25 crit resistance instead of +20 armour / +20 crit resistance once the unit is reduced to 25% or less starting health.

Female Chem Troopers now have an explosive projectile weapon rather than a flamer. They now do 50% blast radius damage to all units adjacent to their target and their range has been increased by 1. Their number of attacks have been reduced from 2 to 1 and range damage slightly increased.
Male Chem Troopers have gained an extra attack and increased range attack damage.

This update includes all new content, bug fixes and balance adjustments of the previous patch. However, it completely removes the experimental camera mode and fixes a critical bug with the camera that was preventing the game from playing normally. Future updates will tweak the camera settings and hopefully add new cinematic camera shots but will do so by building on top of the existing system as opposed to making something completely new.
Added new cinematic camera mode (please enable in game options) that has a more dynamic camera follow behaviour during the player and enemy turns.
Added radar blips to enemies that are not in line of sight so as to give an indication of the presence of enemy units on the map without identifying the exact enemy variant.
Portals, teleporters, explosive terrain objects and reprogrammable units are now always visible regardless of line of sight like other terrain.
New items added for swords, sniper rifles and lightning guns.
Units that can be reprogrammed now have a white coloured life indicator on them.
Increased size of team unit summary in HUD and added indicator of each character's remaining movement range using a green bar.
Increased speed of camera rotate and pan.
Added drag and drop as a way of moving items / equipment in shop and inventory screens.
Hydra Assault Tank can now use all of its abilities.
Flamer weapons and rocket launchers no longer grant bonuses to hit (since they auto-hit).
Characters that automatically hit no longer gain ranged attack skill bonuses from level ups and instead gain other abilities.
Morale impact for killing enemies increased.
Increased base attacks of Technomancers from 1 to 3.
Reduced number of high level enemies on campaign mission 15.

Completely redesigned battle HUD. Team information is shown on the bottom left along with details of the currently selected team member. Skills are shown on the bottom row (with unavailable skills hidden) and other buttons on the bottom right. All UI elements appear on the bottom of the screen to leave the rest of the screen clear.
Camera now follows the active character during movement.

Added a very basic action camera for a close up of attacks. Please select the desired frequency from the game options menu. This feature is still in development and will be improved drastically in upcoming builds.
The project life circles around units now vary by color to show unit faction. Player characters are in cyan, allies in yellow and enemies in red.
The female Tesla Trooper and male Bastion received new personal energy field effects for their respective shield skills.
Ability icons and Abilities from equipment now appear in order of ascending AP cost in the battle HUD.
Removed the explosion sound effect when game starts.
Removed the shuffle sounds that appear at the start of a battle.
Various minor fixes.
Reduced difficulty curve of levels 13 - 19.
Today's patch focusses on fixing gameplay option bugs and easing the difficulty curve in the latter half of the desert campaign.
Fixes a bug where sounds were being cut off prematurely while being played.
Fixed a bug where ambient background sounds were not playing properly.
Fixed a bug where global sound options were not applying to some button press sounds and some effect sounds.
Fixes a bug where key mapping changes were not being saved once the game quit.
Fixes odd behavior with the Optical Enhancement ability that would cause the game to hang for a few seconds.
Fixes unusual navigation behavior in campaign 6.
Added the Veteran Mutant unit in early campaign levels.
Moved several of the stronger creatures such as Ripper Dogs, Grunts and Grunt Heavy Gunners to later in the campaign to ease spike in difficulty at campaign levels 7 to 12.
Reduced number of portals in campaign levels 7 - 12.
Replaced several stronger units in campaign 7, 9 and 11 with the Veteran Mutant unit.
Increased effect of Personal Cloak ability to +45 evasion.
Psychic Death Scream ability now only hurts aliens and not humans.
Increased move speed of Bastion Male class.

topNew: Added the Veteran Mutant unit in early campaign levels.

items.text: Added ability to remap keyboard controls.
Added new options screen that provides more control over graphics, audio and gameplay options.
Added new post processing options such as motion blur and depth of field (configurable in game options).
Added the ability to adjust graphics, audio and input options during battle.
Added ability to all adjust sound categories separately including ambient noises, SFX, music, footstep sounds, voice, sfx reverb and overall Bass.
Added a unique game cursor.
Increased movement stat and missile damage of both Bastion classes.
Reduced enemy patrols and number of enemies on campaign missions 7, 8 and 10 to reduce difficulty curve.
Capped the maximum number of enemies that alien portals can summon during a battle.
Alien portals now explode when destroyed and do damage to all units within a 2 tile radius (similar to fuel containers).
Increased staring action points total of male and female technomancers.
Fixed bug where hologram effect was not appearing for Technomancer male and Sniper female classes when performing holo-shield and shadow field effects.
Several minor typos and bugs fixed.: Please note that you may need to configure the options for your machine and personal preferences.

topNew: Added new options screen that provides more control over graphics, audio and gameplay options.
Added new post processing options such as motion blur and depth of field (configurable in game options).
Added the ability to adjust graphics, audio and input options during battle.

items.text: The unit stat sheet used in the team selection, character switch, battle and inventory / shop scenes have been updated to be easier to read. They also include tooltip prompts to explain what each stat represents in the game.
Balance change where critical hits now no longer ignore the target's armor but does 2.5x the damage it would otherwise have done.
Various minor bug fixes.
A minor patch today that addresses some bugs we didn't catch before launch. Thanks for the community for identifying them.
Fixed bug where auto team selection was not selecting an appropriate team and the corresponding character portraits were not saved.
Fixed a bug where lower graphics settings were hiding some objects and characters completely.
Fixed a bug where footstep and other sound effects were not being played for the male sniper class.

Adjusted stats of Devourer unit by reducing its attack number, attack skill, evasion, armour and removed its access to the Explosive Rounds ability. Slightly increased its armour penetration stat and granted it the Guard skill.
Reduced texture sizes of some textures to improve performance.
